messages:
Vik: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's indexer-rebalance incident. Main asks: assign owners for (1) noise suppression/dedupe, (2) threshold re-calibration, (3) paging policy + runbook updates. Keep items small and test in staging.
Hannah: I can own noise suppression/dedupe. Plan: add group_by labels [service, instance_group] and an Alertmanager inhibit that collapses identical alerts from the same group for 10m. Will prototype on indexer-service.
Luis: I'll take thresholds. Action: compute 21d rolling baseline, set warning = mean+3sigma, page = mean+6sigma for indexer ops, add 2-eval gating in 6m to page. Will push a job to generate numbers by Wed.
Vik: timeline suggestions: Hannah due 2026-04-08, Luis due 2026-04-15, Maggie to update runbook by 2026-03-31. Weekly sync Mondays 08:30 PT.
sre-bot: created ticket ONCALL-11077 assigned to Hannah (noise), ONCALL-11078 assigned to Luis (thresholds). Links: https://redwood/ONCALL-11077, https://redwood/ONCALL-11078
Hannah: initial rule I'll test in staging:
```
- alert: IndexerRebalanceErrors
  expr: increase(indexer_errors_total[5m]) > 4
  labels:
    service: indexer
    severity: page
```
Then apply Alertmanager grouping by (service, instance_group) + group_interval: 8m. Also adding a pre-filter to ignore alerts tagged with `rebalancing=true`.
Maggie: I'll own runbook and paging cadence. Proposal: for indexer-related pages, first escalation at 6m but suppress duplicates for 20m. Add a section for "expected rebalance spikes" with checklist for oncall (check cluster autoscaler, check rebalance logs).
Luis: additional proposal: add a metric tag `rebalancing=true` emitted by the controller during planned rebalances; map that to warning-only for 5m. Also will push a small anomaly-detector threshold to reduce sensitivity during noisy windows.
Vik: can we do a canary? Hannah, enable dedupe in staging for indexer for 48h and report unique vs total alerts. If dup rate drops >50%, we roll to prod.
Hannah: yes. I'll open PR `alert/dedupe/indexer-ONCALL-11077` and enable in staging after tests.
pager-bot: applied temporary 3h silence to indexer-errors for validation window.
sre-bot: note: recurring pattern observed = indexer rebalance + autoscaler churn in eu-west causing repeated 503s and duplicate pages. Capture sample logs and add to postmortem.
Maggie: I'll add the sample logs and update the follow-up table in the postmortem doc with owners/dates. Also will update runbook links to the ticket.
Vik: good. Put all progress in the tickets (single source of truth). Add calendar invite for Monday syncs. Thanks — small, measurable wins first. :thumbsup:
